title: Base Data Element Configuration
description: Common configuration properties shared by all data-driven elements

id.description: Unique identifier for this element (used for referencing in event listeners)

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds; element auto-finishes when elapsed exceeds this. -1 (default) means no auto-finish

eventListeners.description: Event listeners that trigger actions on this element or its children

action.description: Method name to call on this element when the event fires (e.g., 'finish', 'playSound')

sourceId.description: Optional: only trigger if event originates from this element ID

filter.description: Optional: additional event detail properties that must match for the listener to trigger
